proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 3844 article gives Malayalam paṭaruka to spread (as fire, plants, odour), creep, climb; paṭarcca climbing of vine, diffusion; paṭarttuka to train, support plants; paṭarppu, paṭappu bush, thicket; paṭal clump of bushes; paṭalam a spreading over, cover, mass.. proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1293 article gives Malayalam kara shore, riverside, land (opp. to sea), coloured border of a cloth; karayan striped cloth; karal border, margin, edge..
